text: Tourist pre-registration may be checked at entry barriers (Kincraig / Picture Palace). Keep your digital receipt or QR ready.
source: Uttarakhand Smart City portal & District Advisory

text: Mall Road is strictly closed to motor vehicles from 4:30 PM to 10:30 PM. Vehicles must park at multi-level lots (Kingcraig or Picture Palace).
Landour has steep, narrow single-lane roads with very limited parking. On busy weekends, strict one-way circulation is enforced. Hill ATMs frequently run dry — carry cash.
Dehradun police operate weekend diversion plans via Purkul / Kuthal Gate. Delays of 30–60 minutes can occur during midday uphill surges.
Authorities periodically restrict tourist two-wheelers during heavy weekend surges. Always carry helmet and full vehicle registration documents.
Mountain descents must conclude before nightfall. Two-wheelers should start descent 45 min before sunset; cars 30 min before sunset.
source: Road safety standard for ghat sections
